project.description: The platform-agnostic native API the engine codes against — NativePlatform, NativeWindow, WindowConfig, the Platform enum. The single sanctioned Panama entry point (the Ffi helper) and NativeException live in supirvast's vastir-ffi, which this depends on and which depends on nothing but the JDK. Platform modules implement this; the engine resolves the active one via ServiceLoader. See docs/native-bindings.md.
